invariants.rationale: The method always returns an Iterator, either from Collections or IOUtils.runMerge, both of which are non-null.
partitionPath is used to call getUpdateHandle and likely should not be null.
fileId is logged and used in downstream method calls, so it should not be null.
recordItr is passed to other methods and checked for hasNext(), so it is expected non-null.
If recordItr had no records, a singleton iterator is returned (which does haveNext() true); otherwise, a result from IOUtils.runMerge is returned.
